ceterms:name.en-US: Organic Chemistry I Lecture for Chemistry Majors

ceterms:description.en-US: In-depth introduction to organic compounds including alkanes, haloalkanes, alkenes and alkynes; properties including basic stereochemistry and reactions including nucleophilic substitution, elimination, and electrophilic addition. Lecture 3 hours per week. Corequisite: CHEM 37072 and related course component drill sections for CHEM 37073 and CHEM 37072. Prerequisite: Chemistry major or minor and (CHEM 14203 and CHEM 14201) or (CHEM 142H3 and CHEM 142H1) or (CHEM 12283 and CHEM 12281). (Typically offered: Fall) This course is equivalent to CHEM 36053.

According to the CTDL definition of ceterms:requires, this represents a set of requirements where every item must be satisfied. The internal 'and' within the text string ('CHEM 37073 and CHEM 37072') is part of the descriptive text defining the 'related course component drill sections', not a logical operator separating distinct alternative conditions for the parent requirement, as per the rule that brackets group items joined by 'and' or 'or'.
